description:
Get a code review of the git changes in the working directory from one or more other AI coding agents, in parallel. By default it reviews everything not yet committed (staged, unstaged and new files); pass base (e.g. "main") to review the whole branch since it left that branch.
consult collects the diff itself and sends it with review instructions, so you only choose the advisors and an optional focus. Advisors are read-only and read the surrounding code to check their findings. Prefer advisors from vendors other than your own.
Each review has its own session_id for follow-ups through ask_agent. Treat findings as claims to verify, not instructions.

agents.description: Which CLIs review the changes, e.g. ["codex", "grok"]

base.description: Branch or commit to compare with, e.g. main. Omit to review uncommitted changes

cwd.description: Directory the advisor can read. Defaults to the directory this server was started in

effort.description: Reasoning effort. Omit for the CLI's default

focus.description: What to look at especially, e.g. "error handling in the retry path"

name: review_changes
title: Review my changes
